_readme: Every value the site needs from Catherine before it goes public.
Fill a value in, save, then run: npm run prelaunch
That tells you what is still outstanding and refuses to pass until the
launch-blocking ones are done. Nothing here is invented; empty means unknown.

contact._email: The address she actually reads. Appears on the legal and press pages, and receives enquiries. LAUNCH BLOCKER.
contact._phone: Optional. Leave empty to omit it from the site.
contact._addressPublic: Confirm she is happy for the street address to be public. If not, replace with 'Biot, Alpes-Maritimes' and keep the exact address for buyers only. LAUNCH BLOCKER.

social._instagram: Full URL, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/… Leave empty to hide the link.
social._newsletter: Buttondown list handle only, e.g. 'catherinemonmarson'. Leave empty to hide the signup.

legal._siret: 14-digit SIRET. Required on a French commercial site. LAUNCH BLOCKER.
legal._status: e.g. 'Artiste-auteur affilié à la Maison des Artistes' or 'Auto-entrepreneur'. LAUNCH BLOCKER.
legal._vatNumber: Leave empty if she is under the franchise en base de TVA; the site then says prices are net of VAT.

mediator._note: Consumer mediator, mandatory for French distance selling. Typically ~€30/yr via a body such as CM2C or Medicys. LAUNCH BLOCKER once anything can be bought online.

shipping._note: All figures in euros, insurance included. The site shows these verbatim, so they must be hers, not estimates. LAUNCH BLOCKER.
shipping._largeWorksQuoted: Sculpture and canvases over 130 cm quoted individually.
shipping._carrier: Who actually ships. Affects the stated delivery times.

terms._buyNowBelow: Works at or under this price show a direct Buy button when a Stripe link exists.
terms._instalmentsAbove: Above this, the page offers payment in three instalments. Confirm she wants to.
terms._returnDays: 14 is the French legal minimum. Raise it if she wants to.

prices._confirmed: The 45 prices came from ArtMajeur and may be stale. Set true once she has reviewed the list. LAUNCH BLOCKER.
